en.headline: Hong Kong coordinating state funeral for late first chief executive Tung Chee-hwa
en.dek: Authorities are preparing arrangements to honour Tung as a deputy national-level leader for his contributions to the one country, two systems framework, the government said it would announce details in due course.
body: Hong Kong authorities are coordinating a state funeral for the city’s first chief executive, Tung Chee-hwa, who died on Tuesday aged 89, sources familiar with the matter said on Thursday.

The arrangements recognise Tung’s rank as a former vice-chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference and his role in implementing the one country, two systems principle after the 1997 handover.

The government’s Administration Wing said it would announce the relevant arrangements in due course. Since the handover only two other local figures, Ann Tse-kai and Henry Fok Ying-tung, have received comparable state funerals in Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 當局正協調董建華國葬安排 稍後公布詳情
zh.dek: 消息指特區政府正為已故首任行政長官董建華籌備國葬，以肯定其作為副國級領導人及對一國兩制的貢獻；政府表示稍後公布安排。
body: 消息人士周四表示，當局正為周二逝世、享年89歲的首任行政長官董建華協調國葬安排。
有關安排旨在肯定董建華曾任全國政協副主席的副國級身份，以及他在1997年回歸後落實一國兩制的貢獻。
政府行政署回應查詢時表示，會適時公布有關安排。回歸以來，香港僅有安子介及霍英東兩位本地人士曾獲類似規格的國葬。
